name: MUMTAZ
description: Crafted in rich tissue silk, this red lehenga is adorned with intricate gold and sequin embroidery for a classic festive finish. Paired with a matching embroidered blouse, it features delicate dori tassel detailing at the front and sequin tassels along the hem and sleeves.

name: PEARLS & PETALS
description: Crafted in silk tissue, this flowing Anarkali is accented with delicate pearl detailing at the neckline and waist, Layered beneath a fully embroidered sheer jacket, pearls and sequins illuminate the intricate embroidery, while the handcrafted pearl tassels cascade across the front, sleeves and hem, adding movement and finesse to the silhouette.
occasion: Occasion wear | Reception | Cocktail | Trousseau | Engagement

name: DAWN & DUSK
description: Crafted in Chanderi silk brocade, this set features statement pants paired with a fully embroidered blouse with tassel detailing at the hem. A structured jacket on top with intricate cuff detailing gives an effortless blend of traditional craftsmanship with contemporary style.
occasion: Reception | Cocktail | Trousseau | Sangeet | Occasion wear

name: ROSE VEIL
description: Crafted in pure satin, this drape skirt paired with a fully embroidered corset is adorned with intricate detailing and finished with delicate tassels along the hem. A choker-style dupatta frames the neckline, accented with statement tassels at the centre for a refined yet distinctive finish.
occasion: Reception | Cocktail | Trousseau | Engagement | Occasion wear

name: SILVER SOIREE
description: Crafted in delicate Chantilly lace, this sage green fish cut gown is illuminated with intricate sequin embroidery and a gracefully draped silhouette. Pearl and sequin embroidery flows along the drape, adding depth and movement to the gown. Finished with cascading silver cutdana tassels from the shoulder to the back & the sleeve, it creates a striking yet elegant evening look.

name: NAGHMA
description: Crafted in pure silk georgette, this classic saree is adorned with intricate all-over sequin embroidery with tassels detailings all over the pallu. Paired with a woven silk georgette blouse, it balances timeless elegance with a contemporary ease.

name: ZARRIN
description: Crafted in pure silk, this green lehenga set is detailed with a heavy dabka and sequin paired with a silk brocade blouse featuring rich dabka and sequin embroidery at the centre, with intricate gold detailing along the neckline and tassels at the hem and sleeves. Paired with a jaal embroidered dupatta, adorned with sequin embroidery, scalloped borders and delicate detailing, this ensemble is a statement of timeless festive elegance.
occasion: Reception | Trousseau | Wedding | Occasion wear | Sangeet

name: KASHISH
description: Crafted in pure Banarasi brocade, this Anarkali has a heavily sequin embellished border with delicate tassel details at the waist and sleeves. Gold zarkan detailing highlights the neckline and back, finished with an elegant dori styled back. Paired with a self-textured dupatta, framed with heavily scalloped borders and an ornate pallu, this ensemble brings together timeless Indian craftsmanship with a festive, contemporary elegance.
occasion: Wedding | Trousseau | Pooja Ceremonies | Occasion wear

name: ADAA
description: Crafted for an evening of understated glamour, this set features a heavily embroidered corset blouse adorned with sequins, stones and pearls. Paired with a fluid tissue organza pre-draped saree, it is finished with delicate tassel detailing along the hem and a statement Matha Patti for a touch of traditional elegance
occasion: Mehendi | Cocktail | Trousseau | Haldi | Engagement | Occasion wear | Wedding

name: AFTERGLOW
description: Crafted in pure satin, this champagne colored drape skirt is paired with a fully embroidered sequin halter-neck blouse, finished with delicate tassels at the hem and intricate dori detailing along the neckline. A relaxed cutwork jacket completes the look with dori detailing at the lapel and tassels at the hem & sleeves, adding an effortless layer of contemporary elegance.
occasion: Reception | Cocktail | Trousseau | Engagement | Occasion wear

name: MALKIYAT
description: Crafted in rich brown, this trail lehenga is layered in Chantilly lace and fully adorned with delicate sequins, finished with a fine zari-embroidered waist belt. The Swarovski and stone-embellished blouse features elegant drop detailing and intricate gold zari work along the bust. Paired with a jaal and heavily embroidered dupatta, framed with a zari and sequin border and finished with pallu drops, the ensemble brings effortless drama to the evening.

name: NAQSH
description: Crafted in a soft rose pink, this fully embroidered 8-kali sharara set features a graceful kurta with a high slit, finished with delicate tassel detailing at the back and hem. Paired with a lightweight silk organza dupatta framed with sequin-embroidered borders, the ensemble brings together traditional charm with an effortless festive elegance.
occasion: Trousseau | Pooja Ceremonies | Sangeet | Occasion wear

name: FANAAH
description: Crafted in a rich champagne and gold palette, this drape saree set features intricate Swarovski and cutwork embroidery on the champagne-toned bodice, flowing into a fully gold drape pallu with gold zari and sequin embroidery. The Chantilly lace pallu is finished with delicate pearl tassels & is paired with a sequin embroidered gold blouse, adorned with tassels along the hem and sleeves.
occasion: Trousseau | Occasion wear | Wedding | Cocktail | Reception

name: GUL-MEHER
tagline: Drape saree with double pallu & blouse
description: Crafted with a modern layered silhouette, this double-pallu drape saree combines texture, shimmer and intricate craftsmanship. The first cutwork pallu is heavily embroidered with cutdana and finished with tassels, while the second pallu is crafted in Swarovski-embellished silk net and accented with delicate tassels. The two-layered body pairs textured sand-wash satin with Swarovski silk net, complemented by a fully sequin-embroidered blouse finished with tassel detailing at the hem.
occasion: Reception | Cocktail | Engagement | Occasion wear | Wedding

name: NAAZ
description: A celebration of movement and light, Naaz is an 8 kali flared bell bottom set crafted in midnight teal net, entirely hand-embellished with rose gold and silver sequin work with matching organic cutwork at the hem. The peplum kurta features a fully embroidered sweetheart V neckline with a flared hem finished with delicate organic cutwork.
occasion: Occasion wear | Cocktail | Reception | Sangeet | Trousseau

name: GULMOHAR
description: A poetic interplay of structure and fluidity, Gulmohar features a layered silk lehenga paired with a sculpted corset and a delicately embroidered cape adorned with intricate 3D floral accents. Ethereal yet striking, it captures the romance of heritage with a distinctly contemporary allure.

name: HEER
description: An ode to timeless romance, Heer is crafted in plush velvet, adorned with intricate embroidery and paired with fluid silk pants. The silk organza dupatta, finished with a rich gold-beige border, adds a regal softness, bringing together opulence and grace in perfect harmony.
occasion: Occasion wear | Pooja Ceremony | Trousseau | Mehendi

name: ZAHIRA
description: A vision of layered elegance, Zahira features a double-layered lehenga paired with a tonal embroidered blouse, creating depth through subtle detailing. Finished with a statement 3D embroidered florals on the jacket, it embodies modern royalty with a refined, sculptural edge.

name: GUL-NOOR
tagline: Embroidered jacket set with embroidered pants
description: A contemporary statement in festive elegance, Gul Noor features intricately embroidered pants paired with a sleek halter neck blouse. Layered with an embroidered jacket and finished with delicate tassel detailing, it blends playful movement with refined craftsmanship.

name: MEHR
tagline: 24 Kali Anarkali jacket set paired with pants
description: Mehr features a 24-kali Anarkali jacket adorned with intricate patchwork embroidery, creating a silhouette rich in movement and depth. Paired with regal brocade chanderi pants in purple, it embodies timeless elegance with a bold, royal charm.
occasion: Occasion wear | Pooja Ceremony | Trousseau | Wedding | Reception

name: RIWAAYAT
description: Riwaayat features a 12-kali sharara adorned with Swarovski detailing, paired with an intricately embroidered kurta. Finished with delicate tassels, it captures the essence of heritage craftsmanship with a luminous, celebratory charm.
occasion: Occasion wear | Pooja Ceremony | Trousseau | Mehendi

name: SAANJH
description: Saanjh features a fluid drape skirt in luminous tissue paired with an intricately embroidered blouse. Layered with a statement cape finished with an embroidered border, it captures the soft glow of twilight with effortless elegance.

name: AAYAT
description: A graceful blend of tradition and modernity, Aayat is crafted in luminous tissue silk, paired with a sculpted peplum featuring intricate cutwork embroidery. The fluid drape meets structured elegance, creating a silhouette that feels effortlessly refined.

name: RUHANI
description: Ruhani is an expression of quiet strength and sensual elegance. Crafted in a rich brown tone, this corset gown features a sculpted bodice that contours the form, paired with fluid embroidered drape sleeves that moves effortlessly with the wearer. The interplay of structure and softness creates a striking yet refined silhouette, designed for celebrations that call for glamour.

name: THE BLUE AFFAIRÈ
tagline: Drape Skirt with Embroidered Blouse set
description: A modern draped skirt with an embroidered waistband paired with a delicately embroidered blouse with sheer pearl detailings. The fluid skirt drape creates graceful movement, while the embroidery adds a refined festive touch. The pearl dupatta and tassel detailings adds to the elegance of the ensemble making it perfect for intimate functions and pre-wedding events.

name: MIDNIGHT HOUR
description: This midnight hour lehenga set features a richly embroidered blouse paired with a layered skirt, embroidered around the broad waist belt and a sheer sequin-embroidered dupatta cape. The dupatta adds drama and movement with its sequin hangings and tassels drops making this ensemble ideal for cocktail nights.

name: OMBRÉ MIRAGE
description: A contemporarily embroidered saree gown in shades of green to silver, features a sculpted corset bodice and a seamless ruched saree drape on the shoulder that transitions through deep green tones. Designed for effortless elegance, this fishtail bottom of the gown keeps it modern yet traditional with the saree pallu.

name: EVENING WINE
description: A rich wine Concept Saree designed with intricate ombré embroidery and a modern silhouette. The deep hue and delicate tassel detailing around the pallu and blouse create a dramatic yet refined look, ideal for evening celebrations.

name: EMERALD WHISPERS
tagline: Embroidered pants with drape kurta set
description: Designed for comfort without compromising on detail, Emerald Whispers captures the poetry of movement and the richness of festive greens with it's intricately embroidered straight pants paired with a softly draped kurta, creating a silhouette that is fluid, elegant, and effortlessly modern. Paired with a fluid dupatta, the ensemble is a perfect for occasions where ease and elegance come together.
occasion: Mehendi | Cocktail | Reception | Intimate Wedding Functions

name: CHAAND SAAYA
description: A contemporary grey kurta crafted with subtle textural embroidery and distinctive button detailing. Clean, minimal, and elegant, this piece is designed for modern men who prefer quiet luxury.

name: FIZA AFTER MIDNIGHT
description: A statement jumpsuit crafted with intricate tonal embroidery, paired with a sheer embroidered cape. This outfit balances structure and fluidity, offering a bold yet graceful alternative to traditional occasion wear. Perfect for women seeking a modern, powerful silhouette without compromising on festive detailing.

name: MINT SOVEREIGN
description: A refreshing mint green kurta featuring tonal embroidery paired with upada silk pants giving a relaxed yet refined silhouette. Designed for comfort and elegance, this piece is ideal for daytime festivities, summer weddings, and intimate celebrations.

name: SILVER LULLABY
description: An ode to modern couture rooted in timeless elegance, this Swarovski Concept Saree in a refined shade of blue-grey redefines ethereal glamour. Paired with a corset-style blouse featuring tone-on-tone embroidery, the ensemble balances structure with fluidity. Feather accents cascade along the pallu and ghera, while delicately paced tassels bring a playful rhythm to movement.

name: SHAAN-E-DUPATTA
description: This fishtail lehenga redefines grandeur with its sculpted silhouette and intricate embroidery. the ensemble comes with a delicately embroidered blouse, a gracefully attached dupatta adorned with lace and emroideery, and a second embroidered dupatta that elevates the lookinto regal perfection. Designed for the bride who treasures heritage yet embraces modernity, this double-dupatta statement is as versatile as it is breathtaking.

name: FEATHERED ROSÈ
description: A statement of fluid elegance, this cape kaftan in pure organza comes alive in soft pnk, detailed with feather accents on the sleeves for a touch of playful drama. Paired with a sculpted drape skirt in luxurious Armani satin, the ensemble blends couture finesse with modern ease.

name: SAGE SYMPHONY
description: A contemporary silhoutte infused with couture detailing, this ensemble features a fluid drape skirt in rich green, cinched with an intricately embroidered waistband that defines elegance. Paired with a delicately embroidered kaftan, finished with playful tassels along the hem, the look strikes the perfect balance between comfort and sophistication.

name: SWAROVSKI SERIES
description: A cision in grey-blue, this Swarovski-studded gown captures the magic of moonlight. The corset-structred bodice is intricately ebroidered, sculpting elegance with every curve, while feather-adorned sleeves add ethereal drama.

name: GLIDED GRACE
description: A statement ensemble crafted for the modern bride's trousseau. This gold cape set features an intricately embroidered cape with delicate tassel details gracing the sleeves and hem. Paired with a structure corset blouse and fluid Armani satin pants, the look balances opulence with contemporary elegance, making it the perfect choice for a destination celebration or festive soirée

name: GULABI NOOR
description: An ethereal suit set in pure organza, dipped in the softest shade of blush pink. The kurta is adorned with delicate threadwork embroidery, while feather-kissed details on the dupatta hem and kurta edges add a dreamy flourish.

name: GOLDEN HOUR
description: A hand-crinkled beige skirt meets an intricately embroidered crepe cutwork shirt, this due blends ease with edge. Perfect for the bride who wants to be effortless, yet unforgettable.

name: SAFFRON DUSK
description: In rich red pure silk, this one-piece suit is embroidered with delicate abkaan and sequin work. Lightweight yet striking, it's made for the modern bride's destination moments.

name: MOONLIT PAUSE
description: a pure crepe gown in soft beige, adorned with delicate embroidery on the sleeves, an ode to effortless grace, perfect for a chic and intimate celebration.

name: CRIMSON WHISPERS
description: A rich red satin shirt styled with effortless grace, paired with a minimal silk velvet printed jacket. Thoughtfully detailed on the sleeves and placket, this look blends understated opulence with contemporary charm perfect for pre-wedding soirées.

name: PRINTED SILENCE
description: a whisper in motion, printed silence is crafted in pure crepe and adorned with delicate prints that speak softly but linger long. A timeless trousseau layer light, expressive, and effortlessly personal.
